translation.text: Metro services run between Tallawong, Martin Place and Central only. Change services at Martin Place

Sunday 3 to Wednesday 6 May 
Nightly from 9:50PM, metro services do not run between Central and Sydenham. Services run between Tallawong and Martin Place, and between Martin Place and Central only.
Change at Martin Place for metro services towards Tallawong or Central, or T4 trains to Sydenham.
For travel to and from Waterloo use local buses or trains from Redfern.

Sunday 3 to Wednesday 6 May
  • Nightly from 9.50pm, metro services do not run between Central and Sydenham. Services run between Tallawong and Martin Place, and between Martin Place and Central only.
  • Change at Martin Place for metro services towards Tallawong or Central, or T4 trains to Sydenham.
  • For travel to and from Waterloo use local buses or trains from Redfern.
  • The last metro service leaves Sydenham at 21:44, Martin Place at 21:53, arriving Tallawong at 22:42.
  • The last metro service to Sydenham leaves Tallawong at 21:00, Martin Place at 21:48, arriving Sydenham at 21:58.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Buses replace metro services between Tallawong and Chatswood. Use trains between Epping or Chatswood and Sydenham
Saturday 9 and Sunday 10 May Metro services do not run between Tallawong and Sydenham.

Saturday 9 and Sunday 10 May 
  • Metro services do not run between Tallawong and Sydenham.
  • Buses replace services between Tallawong and Chatswood only.
  • For travel to and from Waterloo use local buses or trains from Redfern.

  • Trackwork also affects trains in the City. For travel between Epping or Chatswood and Sydenham use:
    • T9 trains between Epping and Central or T1 trains between Chatswood and Wynyard
    • L2 or L3 light rail services between Wynyard and Central
    • T4 trains between Martin Place and Sydenham.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
10M Epping, all stations to Chatswood and return
11M Tallawong, all stations to Chatswood and return
12M Tallawong, all stations to Epping, then North Ryde, Chatswood and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.
Buses replace metro services between Tallawong and Chatswood. Use trains between Chatswood and Sydenham
Saturday 16 and Sunday 17 May Metro services do not run between Tallawong and Sydenham.

Saturday 16 and Sunday 17 May    
  • Metro services do not run between Tallawong and Sydenham.
  • Buses replace services between Tallawong and Chatswood only.
  • For travel to and from Waterloo use local buses or trains from Redfern.

  • Trackwork on the T9 Northern Line may also affect how you travel. Buses replace trains between Hornsby and Strathfield.

  • For travel between Chatswood and Sydenham use:
    • T1 trains between Chatswood and the City
    • T4 trains between Martin Place and Sydenham
